title: Trade session state machine
desc: Server-authoritative trade flow: request, offers, READY, enforced wait, CONFIRM, atomic swap, rate-limited remote.

title: Atomic inventory swap
desc: All-or-nothing swap of two item sets with ownership, duplicate, lock, capacity and id-collision checks.

title: Pending delivery inbox
desc: DataStore mailbox to deliver items to offline or other-server players, claimed on join or ping.

title: Trade machine server
desc: Same-server pet trade with READY->wait->CONFIRM, edit cooldowns, request expiry and action rate limit.

title: Trade bridge atomic swap
desc: Excerpt: data-owner BindableFunction that lists tradable pets and executes an all-or-nothing swap.

title: Code-built trade UI
desc: Complete trade window built in code: lobby, request cards with timers, offer grids, ready/confirm countdown.

title: Cross-server escrow trade
desc: Cross-server trade that escrows pets per server then delivers through a DataStore inbox with offer signatures.

title: Tool trade server
desc: Clean trade module for Tool items with InTrade lock, request timeout and final re-validation.

title: Tool trade client
desc: Client for tool trades: request toasts with countdown, player list, viewport item previews.

title: Cross-server trade service
desc: Trades across servers using MemoryStore sessions, a presence map for search, and MessagingService sync.

title: Cross-server trade client
desc: Client with live cross-server player search, request popup and offer grids.

title: Podium trade service
desc: Production trade service for base animals: invites, local and cross-server handshake, ready delay, steal checks.

title: Knit trade service
desc: Knit trade of stackable items plus currency tokens with separate ready and confirm stages.

title: Trading plaza booths
desc: Booth marketplace with escrowed listings and token purchases (has known bugs, see README).

title: OOP trade class
desc: Trade object with Trove cleanup, state tracker and attribute-replicated state; unreadies on data change.

title: OOP trade request
desc: Trade request object decided by the target via RemoteFunction, then creates the Trade.

title: Trade eligibility check
desc: canOccur gate: both loaded, target allows trades, neither already trading.

title: Instance-based trade handler
desc: Trade state as a cloned Folder of Value objects, confirm then accept, save lock while swapping.

title: NPC recipe trader
desc: Rotating NPC offers that consume a recipe of brainrots; contains an insecure update remote to remove.
